buyer.name: Lighthouse Learning Group / PSG Clifton International School (formerly Pathways School Gurgaon)

records.trigger_summary: Lighthouse Learning (EuroKids/EuroSchool group) took ownership of an IB school and rebranded it, which typically triggers systems consolidation into the group's school operations, ERP and academic stack.
records.what_happened: Lighthouse Learning assumed ownership of Pathways School Gurgaon, which was renamed PSG Clifton International School under a partnership with the UK's Clifton College.
records.source_title: Lighthouse Learning assumes ownership of Pathways School Gurgaon, renames the institution PSG Clifton International School
records.source_excerpt: Lighthouse Learning has assumed ownership of Pathways School Gurgaon, one of India’s most prominent IB schools.
records.buyer_segment: Multi-campus school group, ownership change (IB school)
records.likely_problem: Integrating a newly acquired school into a group's operating and data systems.
records.what_we_could_sell: Scholar One (integrated platform) or Scholar Core (ERP) for post-acquisition standardisation, with Scholar Insight for group-level reporting.

scores.reasoning: Ownership change at a multi-school group is a genuine systems-review moment, but the page says nothing about technology plans, and it is in Haryana, outside the priority states. Source is a syndicated press release (ANI/VMPL) on ThePrint.
